title: Ghatotkacha

camera: Heroic medium — named cast fills the frame, distant ranks only in the background
frame: Carved gold-and-lotus cartouche integrated into the painting (Ep 10 field-master / Ep 09 counsel) — not a thin rectangular sticker on a cream mat
prompt_prefix: Premium Amar Chitra / painted-comic illustration, native 3:2 canvas at least 1536×1024. ghatotkacha.face: Adult rakshasa-kshatriya prince, broad noble face, dark mustache, fierce dark eyes — never a child, never a horror mask
ghatotkacha.hair: Dark hair, small gold diadem (not Arjuna’s heavy crown, not Krishna’s peacock)
ghatotkacha.costume: Storm-indigo and gold engraved armor, cream sash, mace — equal human scale, heroic medium fill, never flower garland, never saffron sage robes

karna.face: Adult king of Anga, proud mustache, sun-warmed skin, resolute eyes — distinct from Arjuna
karna.hair: Dark hair, jeweled Anga diadem (not Arjuna’s heavy crown, not peacock feather)
karna.costume: Deep gold and crimson engraved armor, Vijaya bow, the Vasavi dart as a gold spear of light — never flower garland, never Krishna pitambar, no divine kavacha

duryodhana.face: Adult Kaurava king, proud mustache, fierce gaze
duryodhana.hair: Dark hair under a jeweled Kuru crown
duryodhana.costume: Jewel-tone gold and saffron Kaurava armor, mace — field king, not a sage

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dusty-blue skin, dark eyes, serene, U-tilak — same face as Ep 09 lock
krishna.hair: Dark curly hair, gold crown with one peacock feather
krishna.costume: Yellow pitambar, flower garlands, gold jewelry, charioteer reins — never a flute, never a bow

arjuna.face: Noble warrior prince, dark mustache, same face as Ep 09–12
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver on back, Gandiva — never flower garland

armies.costume: Muted night banners, equal human scale, no gore

source_block.parva: Drona Parva · night of the fourteenth · Ghatotkacha-vadha · Vasavi Shakti
source_block.divergence: BORI CE / Debroy place the night battle after Jayadratha’s fall, Ghatotkacha’s night prowess, the storm of illusions against the Kauravas, Duryodhana’s plea, Karna’s use of Indra’s one-shot Vasavi Shakti (kept for Arjuna), and Ghatotkacha’s fall in Drona Parva (Ghatotkacha-vadha). Ganguli’s vulgate English maps the same night-storm–Shakti–fall beats. Gita Press Gorakhpur tells the same fourteenth-night arc under its Drona numbering. Beats agree: night relief → Ghatotkacha unleashed → storm → plea → Shakti → fall → Arjuna spared. Exact maya catalogue varies by recension; this episode keeps educational cause→effect without gore.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press Gorakhpur + BORI/Debroy overlap for the night storm and Shakti spend. Ganguli for English Ghatotkacha / Karna wording.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology only. Ghatotkacha = adult rakshasa-kshatriya prince (never child, never horror). No gore: gold Shakti-light; mountain-fall of light. Shakti = one-use celestial spear from Indra, saved for Arjuna. Karna has already given away kavacha-kundala. Krishna = Ep 09 look lock. Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold or this episode’s plate-wide-gold as Imagine refs. Stills binaries untouched this logic pass — GATE C not re-run. Plate ids not renamed; script beat order reordered so storm precedes the Kaurava plea.
